suites.title: QA-05 Release 2: request → RFQ → award → PO

procurement sees the task, buys helmets from the live market and sends the rest to an RFQ
supplier A asks a question; procurement answers it for all bidders

supplier accepts the price request; procurement awards and it goes to Finance

supplier finance issues the ZATCA e-invoice for accepted quantities; buyer finance matches and pays
buyer rates the supplier, raises a short-delivery dispute; Tawreed resolves it
market order (helmets) is fulfilled and paid automatically under the auto-pay limit
